title: Bottled Breath

sources.title: Bottled Breath
markers: an unlimited number of times per Long Rest.

sources.title: Bottled Breath (condition)
markers: | effects = * Affected Entity is able to cast {{sai|Gust of Wind}} once per long rest.

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to gain one use of Gust of Wind until Long Rest.

fields.Effect: Drink as a Bonus Action to gain one use of Gust of Wind until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Gust of Wind: Action. Clear clouds in a 40 ft line from yourself. A creature that fails a Strength save against your spell save DC is pushed about 16 ft and becomes Off Balance for 1 turn.
fields.Reported bug: The tooltip lists one cast, but the pinned item and condition report that the potion permits unlimited casts until Long Rest.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Completed the item-specific action, timing, save, or effect against pinned evidence. Distinguished the tooltip charge limit from the reported repeat-cast bug.
